goal: Wire each comparator execution to immutable selected attempt custody without creating model output, permission grants, automatic retries or live provider requests.
procedure: Require explicit attempt custody and task-ID resolver for each comparator execution; prepare the exact ExecutionRequest and actual ProviderRequest under selected capture authority; keep source-only preflight and acceptance checks separate from single-use wrapped dispatch authorization; pass the bound sink per client.generate call; verify enrolled exchange and independently recovered durable response before recording an accepted comparison; reject missing capture, wrong task marker or source-only replay; recover failure usage only from the exact signed captured task; cache validated metadata under exact plan/case/phase/context for timeout and cancellation runner reporting, with no private read in the hook; isolate concurrent transport sinks and retain constructor sink compatibility only for explicit mock HTTP fixtures.
authority: Procedure trace only. This creates no disclosure or capture grants, chooses no provider deployment, trains no model and supplies no benchmark target or behavioral result.
validation: Nineteen comparator unit contracts and thirteen optional OpenAI transport fixture contracts pass locally. All response bytes are fictional fixtures; no actual provider request or learned inference occurred. Selected integration fixtures wire the real ledger and await their physical backend gate.
failure_or_lesson: A globally injected sink cannot bind concurrent or retried execution rows. Source disclosure alone is not a unique dispatch task authorization. A signed response can still be absent from durable custody, and exception-declared metering cannot prove a consumed call. Timeout or cancellation must preserve only independently observed usage without changing their control behavior or borrowing an earlier execution cache. Even a signed response can carry counters inconsistent with its captured body; only independent exact-task capture verification supplies those counters.
